description:
List Outreach mailboxes (connected sender email accounts). Example: {}

Returns mailboxes with email address, send/sync status, and owning user.
WORKFLOW: Use the returned IDs as mailbox_id when enrolling a prospect with
outreach_add_prospect_to_sequence.

page_offset.description: Record offset into the result list for pagination (maps to the API's page[offset]; e.g. 25 for the second page with limit 25)

user_id.description: Filter mailboxes owned by a specific Outreach user

name: outreach_list_mailboxes
